contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Advance seed with xorshift32: substitute 0x2545F491 for zero, then signed-32-bit x ^= x << 13, x ^= x >>> 17, x ^= x << 5. Return abs(advanced state) modulo bound. This is deterministic, not an entropy source.
contract.domain: Seed is a signed 32-bit integer; bound is an integer from 1 through 1000.
contract.outputRole: bucket selected from the advanced state, not the old seed
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
